owner.name: Arwin Edward M. Bagaslao
owner.headline: AI Engineer shipping production multi agent systems that run real businesses
owner.summary: I build AI systems that run real businesses, not demos. 55 systems in production across finance, ecommerce, sales and media, orchestrated by 49 specialized agents. My code moves real payroll and supplier money through a bank with no public API, runs an 80k line finance ERP on Google free tier, built event driven stock sync across four sales channels, and heals its own scheduler when jobs fail. I own the whole loop, from the business problem to the deployed and monitored system, and I replace paid SaaS with tools that cost nothing to run.

headliners: 55 systems in production across finance, ecommerce, sales, media and trading, not demos
49 specialized agents orchestrated across an 18 region brain map, each with a single owned job
Moves real payroll and supplier money end to end through a bank UI with no public API, with readback gates and duplicate send guards
CITADEL Finance OS: an 80k line custom ERP on Google free tier, approvals, ledger, payroll and a sealed bank perimeter
Event driven 4 channel stock sync: one sale on any channel converts to ml and updates the other three
Replaced paid SaaS with free self hosted tools: lead database, email engine, document signing, BIR certificate generator
Self healing ops: failed jobs are auto filed and auto fixed, zombie processes reaped, heavy jobs queued on an 8GB machine
PHOENIX persistent runner: long tasks survive usage limits and context resets until DONE
Live trading bots with supervisor agents and watchdogs that catch derailment, not just crashes
ARWIN REVIEWS: 1,620 film media brand with an AI predictor, review cards and cross posting on autopilot
